resources.string: Your caption stays in the message field so you can send it separately.

No compression or server upload. The recipient must accept; both phones need to be available. Transfer pauses when a direct connection is unavailable and can resume later.
The saved part does not match the original. Delete only this unfinished part and receive the file from the beginning?
The file could not be opened. Check its availability on this device and try again.
A direct connection is unavailable. No file was uploaded to the server.
The saved part does not match the original.
Not enough storage. Free space and resume.
The original is no longer available. Select it again.
Update the UNYRI server to enable direct transfers.
File verification failed. The unfinished file will not open.
Transfer authentication failed. Check your contact’s security key.
Transfer paused. The saved part is retained.
Original file · waiting for your approval
Direct files can be up to 64 GiB, subject to available storage.
Up to 8 pending direct transfers. Finish or cancel an earlier one.
The original could not be prepared. Check access to the file, storage and connection.
Files over 100 MB need an available one-to-one chat with another person. Open one, or choose a smaller file for this conversation.
This file exceeds 100 MB. Direct transfer is unavailable in this conversation. Choose a smaller file or open an available one-to-one chat.
Direct files are not included in history backups. Ask the sender to send the file again.
